operations.name: create_extract
operations.description: Use AI to analyze video content and extract structured data. Provide either a prompt describing what to extract, a JSON Schema for the output format, or both. Supports YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, and Facebook videos, or a direct video file URL. Videos up to 3 hours (180 minutes) and files up to 2 GB are supported; the whole video is analyzed (1 frame per second up to 80 minutes, a lower evenly-spaced frame rate beyond). Over-limit YouTube and file URLs are rejected with 400 before a job is created. Returns a job ID for asynchronous processing. Use the `/extract/:jobId` endpoint to poll for results.
